for_each_body_steps.name: Lua transform
for_each_body_steps.script:
local months = {Jan=1,Feb=2,Mar=3,Apr=4,May=5,Jun=6,Jul=7,Aug=8,Sep=9,Oct=10,Nov=11,Dec=12}

local function iso_from_gmail_date(s)
  if type(s) ~= "string" or s == "" then return nil end
  local cleaned = s:gsub("%s*%([^)]+%)%s*$", "")
  cleaned = cleaned:gsub("^[%a]+, ", "")
  local day, mon, year, hh, mm, ss, tzsign, tzh, tzm =
    cleaned:match("(%d%d?) (%a%a%a) (%d%d%d%d) (%d%d):(%d%d):(%d%d) ([+-])(%d%d)(%d%d)")
  if not day then return nil end
  local m = months[mon]
  if not m then return nil end
  return string.format(
    "%04d-%02d-%02dT%s:%s:%s%s%s:%s",
    tonumber(year), m, tonumber(day), hh, mm, ss, tzsign, tzh, tzm
  )
end

return {
  external_id = input.external_user_id,
  from_email = item.from,
  gmail_id = item.id,
  received_at = iso_from_gmail_date(item.date),
  snippet = item.snippet,
  source = "backfill",
  subject = item.subject,
  synced_at = input.synced_at,
  thread_id = item.thread_id,
}
